historical_exposure_scope.winner_authorization: A winner authorizes only a future separately preregistered fresh train confirmation. That preregistration must freeze a complete historical gate/calibration/confirmation exposure registry and exclude every group in its union, including all nine group_ids listed here.

protocol.equaltrace_covariance: C_equaltrace=sum_i C_i/trace(C_i), with each trace finite and strictly positive
protocol.future_window: All stored frames strictly after the second registered onset observation.
protocol.metric_weighted_ls: For each rank and spatial point, argmin_a sum_t w_t (r_t-B_t a)^2 with w_t=1/max(||truth_t||_2^2,1e-30).

metrics.paired_changes: Each arm versus the same parent plus weighted-minus-ordinary and equaltrace-minus-raw within rank and family.
metrics.raw_residual_energy_capture: 1-||residual-correction||_2^2/||residual||_2^2 using unweighted future-field energy; diagnostic only

protocol.ordinary_ls: For each rank and spatial point, argmin_a sum_t (r_t-B_t a)^2 on exposed train future frames.
protocol.raw_covariance: C_raw=sum_i C_i, where C_i=sum over spatial chunks of R_i R_i^T and R_i=truth_i-parent_i for a basis record
protocol.same_generation_contract: Within a family, each record's parent/truth/residual is generated once in memory; each basis residual updates both covariance arms and the exposed calibration tensors are reused by all four arms and all ranks.
protocol.streaming_and_serialization: Covariances are accumulated by spatial chunks. Parent, truth, residual, coefficient, correction, and corrected fields are never serialized.
protocol.weighted_objective_identity: Summing the weighted LS objective over spatial points and dividing by frame count exactly equals mean squared per-frame relative L2 under the same denominator floor.
protocol.weighted_objective_limitation: Metric-weighted LS does not exactly minimize mean unsquared per-frame relative L2.

truth_scope.basis_truth_use: all 401 frames only for the two covariance arms
truth_scope.calibration_truth_use: future frames for oracle coefficient fit, weights, and scoring
